name: Deprecated serviceAccount field
description: The deprecated `serviceAccount` workload field should not be used. Use `serviceAccountName` instead.
long_description: In early versions of Kubernetes, the `serviceAccount` field was used in Pod specifications. It was deprecated in favor of `serviceAccountName` to avoid confusion and maintain API consistency across workloads. Continuing to rely on deprecated fields increases the risk of compatibility issues during Kubernetes cluster upgrades and manifests syntax confusion. Workload manifests should exclusively use `serviceAccountName` to define pod service accounts.
remediation: Replace the deprecated `serviceAccount` field with `serviceAccountName` using the same service account value.
test: Check that Pods, workload pod templates, and CronJob pod templates do not use the deprecated serviceAccount field.
